proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Demonstration 1 (required items: s1):
  0: {at(0,7)} E
  1: {at(1,7)} INTERACT
  2: {at(1,7), hasCart} N
  3: {at(1,6), hasCart} E
  4: {at(2,6), hasCart} E
  5: {at(3,6), hasCart} E
  6: {at(4,6), hasCart} E
  7: {at(5,6), hasCart} E
  8: {at(6,6), hasCart} INTERACT
  9: {at(6,6), hasCart} S
 10: {at(6,7), hasCart} E
 11: {at(7,7), hasCart} E
 12: {at(8,7), hasCart} E
 13: {at(9,7), hasCart} E
 14: {at(10,7), hasCart} E
 15: {at(11,7), hasCart} EXIT
 16: {at(11,7), hasCart} <terminal>

Propose norms using ONLY the atoms listed above. Do NOT define any new state properties or events: "abstraction" must be {}.
Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

Shoppers are obliged to visit the cart bay at cell (1,7).

Shoppers are prohibited from entering the exit corridor cells unless they have a cart.

A shopper may not interact with shelves in a shelf-flanked single-file aisle while holding a cart.

After returning from a shelf-flanked single-file aisle to its mouth without a cart, the shopper is obliged to retrieve the parked cart.

                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: Shopping carts are prohibited in shelf-flanked single-file aisles.
A shopper must not push a cart into a shelf-flanked single-file aisle.
A shopper may not interact with shelves in a shelf-flanked single-file aisle while holding a cart.
When a shopper reaches the mouth of the narrow shelf aisle with a cart, they are obliged to park the cart there before entering.
After parking a cart, a shopper is obliged to retrieve a cart again before the trip ends.
A shopper who is at the narrow-aisle cart parking point without a cart must not leave into the open store area without first retrieving the cart.
A shopper may abandon or park a cart only in a sufficiently wide pullout area.
After returning from a shelf-flanked single-file aisle to its mouth without a cart, the shopper is obliged to retrieve the parked cart.

accepted.description: [g1_no_carts_single_file] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileShelfAisle := (shelfFlanked ∧ freeWidthH≤1)

[g1_no_enter_single_file_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: enterSingleFileWithCart  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileShelfAisle := (shelfFlanked ∧ freeWidthH≤1); enterSingleFileWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · singleFileShelfAisle
[g1_no_cart_shelf_service_in_single_file] FORBIDDEN: (INTERACT ∧ hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileShelfAisle := (shelfFlanked ∧ freeWidthH≤1)

[g1_park_at_narrow_aisle_mouth] OBLIGED: after cartAtNarrowAisleMouth, eventually parkCartAtMouth (before exit)  where cartAtNarrowAisleMouth := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ hasCart); narrowAisleMouth := at(6,3); parkCartAtMouth := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · (narrowAisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart)
[g1_retrieve_parked_cart] OBLIGED: after parkCart, eventually retrieveCart (before exit)  where parkCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; retrieveCart := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart

[g1_no_leave_mouth_without_cart] FORBIDDEN: departMouthWithoutCartIntoOpenStore  where narrowAisleMouth := at(6,3); wideOpenAwayFromMouth := (wideOpenStoreArea ∧ ¬narrowAisleMouth); wideOpenStoreArea := (freeWidthH≥12 ∧ freeWidthV≥5); departMouthWithoutCartIntoOpenStore := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ MOVE) · wideOpenAwayFromMouth
[g1_cart_drop_only_wide_pullout] FORBIDDEN: (abandonCart ∧ ¬wideCartParkingSpot)  where wideCartParkingSpot := (freeWidthH≥12 ∧ freeWidthV≥5); abandonCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

[g1_retrieve_after_return_from_single_file] OBLIGED: after returnToMouthWithoutCart, eventually retrieveCartAtMouth (before exit)  where narrowAisleMouth := at(6,3); shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileShelfAisle := (shelfFlanked ∧ freeWidthH≤1); retrieveCartAtMouth := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · (narrowAisleMouth ∧ hasCart); returnToMouthWithoutCart := (singleFileShelfAisle ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ S) · narrowAisleMouth
